name: oh-my-herdr
description: OmO-style multi-agent orchestration on herdr: Claude Code leads, worker agents run in herdr panes.

display.title: Progress display
display.description: Where the run's progress (omh ██░░░░ 2/5) shows while a run is open. statusline: at the end of Claude Code's own hint line under the prompt. panel: a row above the prompt, with the wave. off: neither. .omh/status.json is written either way, for a custom status line.

wakeOnSettle.title: Wake the lead
wakeOnSettle.description: Submit a prompt to the lead when a wave settles or a worker needs it, so it never waits in a turn.

notifyHuman.title: herdr notifications
notifyHuman.description: Show a herdr notification (with sound) when a worker is blocked or a wave settles.

autoContinue.title: Auto-continue
autoContinue.description: When a turn ends with open tasks or gates and no worker busy, prompt the lead to keep going (Sisyphus mode).

autoContinueMax.title: Auto-continue limit
autoContinueMax.description: Most auto-continue prompts in a row; any prompt you type resets the count.

verbose.title: Verbose tool rows
verbose.description: Show the omh_* tool calls in full (the whole brief, plan.md or plan, and the whole result). Off: one line per call and the result's first line; ctrl+o still shows everything.
